jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
An exciting opportunity for Communications professionals with a passion for science and making a positive impact on patient lives. You have the opportunity to excel in a matrix environment, working alongside the best minds of healthcare, who nurture and challenge for the best outcomes. If this interests you, we invite you to apply for this role.
Tasks & responsibilities

- As the future Senior Manager - Medicine Communications (HP), you will shape and coordinate the global execution of the Global Medicine Communications Strategic Agenda.
- Moreover, you will ensure Medicine campaigns align with the Global Comms Strategic Agenda, working closely with other functional teams and stakeholders.
- Specifically, you will partner with the Human Pharma Medicine organization to position our leadership in science to diverse industry stakeholders. Your role will be crucial in strengthening Medicine's reputation as a key pillar within Human Pharma.
- Furthermore, you will advise senior management on employee engagement and communication rhythms. You will also be responsible for implementing a proportionate and strategic calendar for senior leaders' communication, both internally and externally.
- You will partner with the Chief Medical Officer in building her stature as a credible voice of science in the industry and a strong voice for our narrative.
- You will develop effective communication platforms and formats, serving as a dedicated Business Partner to relevant stakeholders.
- Moreover, you will be responsible for implementing global governance and core processes for all key areas, for ensuring consistent and flawless internal and external communications and support liaising with senior leadership.
- Leveraging your experience, you will build a strong team to support transformation and change processes in Business Units and Group Functions.

Requirements

- University degree in Mass communication / Journalism / Media Management with long-term experience in communications / mass communication and several years' experience in managing senior leadership / executive teams
- Proven track record in strategic leadership communications and experience in a matrixed organization in the healthcare industry
- Excellent editorial and copywriting skills with a broad scope as well as experience in crisis and issues management
- Knowledge of traditional and new age media working models and analytics; Qualifications in digital communication / social media management is an added advantage
- Ability to transform a strategic vision into specific actions and plans and to anticipate business challenges, trends as well as internal and external stakeholders' needs
- Experience in working with the C-suite, managing expectations, executing 360-degree campaigns with multi-stakeholder groups
- Excellent verbal and written command in English. Knowledge of other international languages is an added advantage

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
WHY BOEHRINGER INGELHEIM?
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.
Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.
Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.
Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com﻿
Ready to contact us?
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com

jobs.occupation: Research associate (m/f/x) in Data Science in Chemistry (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
In order to fill a fixed-term position in full-time (39.83 hours/week = 100%) at the earliest possible date, we are looking for a

Research associate (m/f/x) in Data Science in Chemistry

At the Chair of Inorganic Chemistry II of the Ruhr University Bochum we address research questions in the fields of organometallic synthesis chemistry and homogeneous catalysis. We are an internationally oriented research team that develops new reagents as well as highly efficient catalysts for synthetic chemistry. By combining advanced synthetic methods, state of the art analytical techniques, quantum chemical calculations, and machine learning methods, we conduct world leading research at the highest international level. Automated analysis of chemical data and the prediction of reactivity, selectivity and yield by means of machine learning are revolutionising modern chemistry. In our group we employ data science methods together with quantum chemical calculations to model reaction networks from experimental data, understand bonding situations and reactivities, and identify new catalysts and reaction conditions in a data driven way.

The Chair of Inorganic Chemistry II (Organometallic Chemistry and Homogeneous Catalysis) is looking for a full time scientific staff member (postdoctoral researcher) (100 % TV L 13) to start immediately. We are looking for a motivated postdoctoral researcher (m/f/x) who, with a passion for interdisciplinary work, will support the design of teaching courses in data science and machine learning and strengthen our group in this area.

Scope: full-time
Duration: fixed-term, 2 Jahre
Start: at the earliest possible date
Apply by:  2026-09-21

Your tasks:

- Quantum‑chemical calculations – perform calculations to elucidate reaction mechanisms, bonding situations and to extract physicochemical properties of molecules
- Model development & validation – create and validate models that clarify structure‑activity relationships and predict properties and reactivities; analyse data with statistical methods and visualise the results
- Collaboration with experimentalists – work closely with laboratory scientists to support and validate data collection
- Project leadership – take responsibility for projects, supervise students, write reports and grant proposals
- Scientific communication – compile results into publications and assist students in preparing manuscripts
- Mentorship – supervise students in their theses and support teaching activities in the areas of Data Science and Machine Learning
- Teaching – support the development and implementation of new student courses in Data Science and Machine Learning

Your profile:

A candidate with a completed university degree and a PhD (preferred) in Chemistry is sought; candidates from related fields such as Data Science or Computer Science with demonstrable knowledge of chemistry are also welcome.

Further requirements:

- Practical experience in quantum‑chemical calculations – familiarity with common quantum‑chemical programs and methods, in particular ORCA, Multiwfn, AIM, etc.
- Practical experience in machine learning & chemistry‑specific data science – programming skills in Python and hands‑on experience with standard libraries such as NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Scikit‑learn, RDKit, PyTorch, etc.
- Practical experience in homogeneous catalysis – desirable, but not mandatory
- Practical experience with the installation and maintenance of high-performance computing clusters – desirable, but not mandatory
- Theoretical knowledge in quantum-chemistry, machine learning, molecular chemistry
- Experience in research project management
- Experience in publishing and presenting scientific results
- Experience in teaching and the supervision of students and interns
- Language skills – English (fluent spoken and written) is required; German is an advantage but not mandatory

Furthermore, the applicant should be open to team‑oriented work and possess a strong motivation for interdisciplinary research.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher Position— Plant Membrane Biochemistry and Chemoproteomics (m/f/d)  (10/2026) (UX-Researcher/in)
jobs.description:
Your area of responsibility The question How does proteolytic regulation control plant plasma-membrane receptor function and plant immune responses? The plant plasma membrane is a dynamic hub for nutrient uptake, pathogen detection and stress signalling, anchored by surface receptors. In animals, proteolytic cleavage of membrane proteins is a major regulatory mechanism in immunity. In plants, its role remains largely unexplored. FRONTERA, funded by the European Research Council through an ERC Starting Grant, sets out to close that gap. The project combines chemoproteomics, cell biology, protease biochemistry and genetics, and looks at both sides of the process: the proteases that cut, and the substrates they act on. It is curiosity-driven research with a long view towards crop resilience and sustainable agriculture. Your tasks: You will lead the membrane biochemistry and chemoproteomics side of FRONTERA: establishing the preparations and the activity-based profiling needed to study proteases where they work, at the plant plasma membrane.
• Develop and optimise membrane preparation methods suited to downstream chemoproteomics
• Apply activity-based protein profiling and mass spectrometry to characterise membrane-associated protease activities, working with our in-house facility
• Relate biochemical findings to immune responses in planta, in collaboration across the group
• Co-supervise a doctoral researcher
• Present and publish your scientific data

Your profile Essential
• A doctoral degree in biochemistry, plant science, molecular biology, chemical biology or a closely related field. If your thesis is submitted but not yet defended by the start date, please apply and tell us your timeline.
• Solid hands-on experience in protein biochemistry
• Real interest in method development, including tolerance for the weeks when a protocol refuses to work
• Interest in mentoring a doctoral researcher
• Excellent English language skills, written and spoken. German is not required.

Desirable
• Membrane protein handling, subcellular fractionation or membrane isolation
• Activity-based protein profiling, chemical probes or related chemical biology
• LC-MS/MS proteomics, from sample preparation to data analysis
• Work with plant systems, including transient expression
• Proteomics data analysis (MaxQuant, FragPipe, Perseus, R, Python)
• Supervision or teaching experience

Read the second list as a description of the project, not a test. Nobody arrives with all of it. Candidates who would do this job well routinely talk themselves out of applying because they match four points instead of six. If the science interests you and you bring the essentials, we would like to see your application. Tell us in your cover letter what you would need to learn.

We offer
• Modern Working Conditions: Comprehensive introduction to work techniques and a modern research environment with state-of-the-art equipment and up-to-date software
• Career Development: Targeted training opportunities and access to a specialized library with electronic resources and quiet workspaces
• Compensation & Security: Classification according to TV-L including annual bonus, pension scheme (VBL), health offers, and discounted canteen meals

Your area of responsibility The question How does proteolytic regulation control plant plasma-membrane receptor function and plant immune responses? The plant plasma membrane is a dynamic hub for nutrient uptake, pathogen detection and stress signalling, anchored by surface receptors. In animals, proteolytic cleavage of membrane proteins is a major regulatory mechanism in immunity. In plants, its role remains largely unexplored. FRONTERA, funded by the European Research Council through an ERC Starting Grant, sets out to close that gap. The project combines chemoproteomics, cell biology, protease biochemistry and genetics, and looks at both sides of the process: the proteases that cut, and the substrates they act on. It is curiosity-driven research with a long view towards crop resilience and sustainable agriculture. Your tasks:
• You will lead the degradomics side of FRONTERA, establishing terminomics in our system to identify cleaved substrates and map where they are cut.
• Establish and optimise a terminomics workflow for plant samples
• Identify protease substrates and determine cleavage sites, and follow how processing changes during immune responses
• Develop the data analysis alongside the wet-lab method, working with our in-house mass spectrometry facility
• Validate candidate cleavage events biochemically and relate them to immune signalling, in collaboration with the team
• Co-supervise a doctoral researcher
• Present and publish your scientific data

• Interest in mentoring a doctoral researcher

You define and own the product security strategy for our global portfolio and establish the policy framework for secure development, security baselines, and release criteria.

You drive CRA readiness across the entire portfolio - from product classification to conformity assessment, and the build-out of SBOM and evidence processes.

You set the mandatory security tooling baseline (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning) and define security quality gates within the delivery pipeline.

You shape the governance for our AI-driven security remediation (agentic OpenCode pipeline) - including guardrails, approval criteria, and quality assurance.

You build the Security Guild and a network of Security Champions embedded in the FIRE teams, and foster lived security practice through training and coaching

Several years of experience in product security, application security, or as a deputy CISO within a complex, multi-product software organisation.

Demonstrable, current expertise in the EU Cyber Resilience Act - requirements, classification logic, and conformity assessment-along with working knowledge of NIS2 and GDPR.

Strong, practical knowledge of the secure development lifecycle, threat modelling, and application security testing, together with hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, and SonarQube tooling.

Experience with SBOM generation and governance, as well as with managing supply chain risk; understanding of AI-assisted and agentic development workflows.

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills to enforce standards without direct line authority; CISSP or an equivalent certification is an advantage.

Fluent in German and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Mobile work: Work flexibly on the move two days a week and on site three days a week.

Attractive locations: In addition to fully equipped workplaces, regular events such as summer parties and Christmas parties await you at our locations.

Development: Our in-house academy and our portfolio of external cooperation partners will support you in your further development.

Health: Health is a valuable asset for us. Our in-house canteen offers a selection of tasty and healthy dishes every day, and we welcome you to our fully equipped fitness center for weekly courses (online & offline).

More is always possible: The kindergarten on our CGM campus in Koblenz helps our employees to organize their working day even more flexibly. We also offer corporate benefits, the option of a job bike, a company pension scheme, and much more.
